g.text: Common families fixed before class/time selection
Latest additional: residual observed E case support at <=20 ms
Exactly one reason per case in the frozen precedence order; reasons describe saved diagnostic selection, not physical failures.
No parent/stratum RP does not establish an unrun experiment or zero error. Supported cases can still lose many pairs.
Class/event/time conditions and original common-family eligibility stay fixed. No new simulation, AUC or causal comparison.
